paragraphs.text: Margaret is retired and there have been no changes to her circumstances or objectives since last year's review. She remains comfortable with the moderate approach to risk that was previously agreed and is satisfied with how the portfolio has performed in line with this.

The main point raised at your meeting was that you currently have cash on deposit in your Holloway cash account and wish to use this year's ISA allowance by moving some of these funds into your Stocks & Shares ISA.
You do not have any current income requirement from the portfolio and do not expect this to change in the near term.
Your current risk profile is assessed as {{value-1}} moderate.
The agreed recommendation is to invest GBP {{value-1}}.
The source of these funds is the cash you hold on deposit in your Holloway cash account.
This will involve making a top up to your existing Stocks & Shares ISA.
This recommendation does not involve selling any existing investments.

It has been agreed that £20,000 will be moved from your cash account into the Stocks & Shares ISA. As this simply moves available cash into the ISA wrapper, there is no disposal of investments involved.
You mentioned that you may wish to discuss gifting to your grandchildren in the future, but confirmed that nothing should be done about this at present.
There is additional confirmation that the product to be topped up is your existing Stocks & Shares ISA, with an investment amount of GBP 20,000, and that no existing investments are being sold.
The recorded funding for this recommendation is cash held on deposit in your Holloway cash account.
